findings.description: Only Table I was partially translated and executed. The shipped master pipeline includes 4,118 lines across data preparation, tables, and figures; the full translation and remaining claims were not completed.
findings.evidence: main.do calls xu_make_data.do, xu_tables.do, and xu_figures.do. The executed R file handles only Table I and reads distributed *_final.dta datasets.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate and run the complete pipeline command by command in R, then enumerate and compare every printed result in the abstract, main text, and tables.

findings.description: Country-level British-bank and non-British-bank summary statistics do not recur in the partial Table I translation.
findings.evidence: Country British banks: printed mean 13.45 and SD 13.82; recomputed 13.27 and 13.65. Non-British banks: printed mean 1.26 and SD 3.25; recomputed 1.28 and 3.28.
findings.suggested_fix: Run the shipped data-preparation pipeline and investigate these differences without changing its specification or sample.
